summary: Four experiments completed in 2.1 minutes. The 1.78-minute synthesis-only receipt dominated elapsed time; the only compute-bound entry, the 0.01-minute gated exact causal counterfactual fixture, was therefore the longest compute task, but the reconstructed timing does not explain its duration. Compute-task GPU idle is false, and no supplied record shows a concurrent multi-model task or missed DualGPURunner engagement.
bottlenecks_identified: The 1.78-minute dated primary-source and implementation receipt was the largest recorded task and dominated the 2.1-minute milestone wall time.
Disk-mtime reconstruction lacks phase-level attribution, so gate, setup, execution, and artifact-write costs cannot be separated for the only compute-bound entry.
The GPU snapshot is not correlated to task execution or model concurrency, limiting direct validation of utilization and runner selection; the locked compute-task idle classification remains false.
improvements_suggested: Add an incremental cache keyed by the prior source cutoff and implementation manifest so an unchanged dated receipt can reuse already-scanned evidence.
Emit gate, setup, execution, and artifact-write timers for every compute-bound task.
Record task-correlated GPU samples, concurrent model count, and selected runner so DualGPURunner can be required only when models actually run in parallel.
Add a milestone-boundary cleanup check for lingering idle GPU allocations without treating synthesis-only GPU idle as a defect.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Cache unchanged primary-source and implementation receipt inputs and report cache-hit timing.
Add phase timers and task-correlated GPU utilization to compute-bound execution receipts.
Persist concurrent model count and runner choice, selecting DualGPURunner only for parallel multi-model work.
meta_reflection: This was a short, synthesis-heavy milestone reconstructed from file modification times, so its ranking is useful but its causal attribution is weak. The next retrospective should use task-correlated phase, GPU, and concurrency telemetry before assigning a nonzero savings forecast.
